item.title: github: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
item.description:
GitHub Desktop 3.6.10+ now supports short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens for eligible accounts. This reduces the time a leaked token remains usable.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Credential revocation and deauthorization by token type
item.description:
GitHub added self-service incident response actions to deauthorize and revoke user credentials by token type and by specific user. The update extends existing credential revocation workflows for security incidents.

  • Source: GitHub
